  "ledger": [
    "00:00–00:09.75: Visual tracking uses timestamped frames at 4 fps. Overlapping, similar-looking olives cannot all be individually identified; batch entries preserve that uncertainty. Audio is unassessed.",
    "00:00–00:04.25: Small glass cup is held in the person's left hand; right fingers restrain and guide its olives over the large jar. The cup is then carried right toward the rear metal bowl.",
    "00:00.50–00:01.25: First distinguishable dark olive appears inside the previously empty large jar, bouncing near its base as green olives fall in. It remains within the jar; overlap prevents later individual identification.",
    "00:00.50–00:01.25: Initial green olives move from the tilted cup, past the right fingertips, through the large jar's mouth and down to its base. At least three green olives are distinguishable near the base by 00:01.25.",
    "00:01.50–00:02.75: Further green and dark olives descend from the hand-controlled cup into the large jar and accumulate over the first arrivals. Individual identities become obscured within the pile.",
    "00:03.00–00:04.25: Remaining green contents are partly visible in the small cup behind the fingers. The hands move the cup away from the jar toward the rear bowl; the deposited pile remains in the large jar.",
    "00:04.25–00:05.25: Hands and cup reach the rear metal bowl; the cup is lowered among its contents and lifted containing olives. The bowl rim and hands obscure individual pickup paths. Several olives and smaller brown pieces remain in the bowl.",
    "00:05.25–00:06.25: Refilled cup travels in the left hand from the rear bowl to above the large jar. Right fingertips contact and restrain the olives at its opening.",
    "00:06.50–00:06.75: A green olive leaves the cup's lip and enters the large jar, joining the existing pile.",
    "00:07.00–00:07.25: Green and dark olives remain visible in the tilted cup behind the right fingertips; the previously deposited olives remain inside the large jar.",
    "00:07.50–00:08.50: Further dark and green olives pass the right fingers and cup lip, fall through the jar opening, and increase the pile. The last clearly sampled falling green olive is visible inside the jar at 00:08.50.",
    "00:08.50–00:09.75: A green olive remains visible near the small cup's base at 00:08.50. The left hand lifts and rotates the cup away; fingers and glass obscure that region intermittently, and green contents are visible again at 00:09.75. The images do not establish that the cup was completely emptied.",
    "00:00–00:09.75: Large receiving jar stays upright on the wooden board. Deposited olives remain inside through the final frame; no retrieval or spill is visible.",
    "00:00–00:09.75: Front-right bowl and its green olives remain on the counter without visible handling. Rear metal bowl remains on the counter during the refill and afterward."
